name: Chicken Fajitas on Whole Wheat Tortillas
description: Grilled chicken and seared peppers folded into whole wheat tortillas with salsa and guacamole.

source.ingredients_text: WHOLE WHEAT FLOUR, WATER, VEGETABLE SHORTENING (INTERESTERIFIED AND HYDROGENATED SOYBEAN OILS), CONTAINS 2% OR LESS OF: SALT, SUGAR, BAKING SODA, SODIUM ACID PYROPHOSPHATE, CELLULOSE GUM, DISTILLED MONOGLYCERIDES, ENZYMES, ASCORBIC ACID, FUMARIC ACID, AND CALCIUM PROPIONATE, SORBIC ACID AND CITRIC ACID (TO MAINTAIN FRESHNESS).
ingredients_list: Vegetable Shortening (Interesterified And Hydrogenated Soybean Oils)
Sorbic Acid And Citric Acid (To Maintain Freshness)

instructions: Sear sliced bell pepper in olive oil until charred at the edges.
Slice grilled chicken and warm with the peppers.
Warm tortillas; fill with chicken, peppers, salsa, and guacamole.
Serve with Organic electrolyte drink (355 g).

nutrition_provenance.note: Vitamins/minerals summed from ingredients with USDA full panels (all raw foods + FDC-matched barcode products). Branded label panels include only nutrients declared on the label.
